_comment: Scripted device states for the local VPN diagnostic mock. Each call to /v1/vpn/diagnose for a device returns the next entry; the last entry repeats. Behaviours: pass, fail, timeout (service sleeps longer than the client timeout), http_error (HTTP 503), malformed (invalid JSON).

LT-4821.detail: GlobalLink 5.1.2 installed; minimum supported version is 6.0.4. Known keep-alive bug causes drops every 5-10 min.

LT-7002.detail: Device certificate serial 4F:22:9A revoked by Identity team on 2026-11-11 (reason: keyCompromise).

LT-8810.detail: vpn-eu1.northwind.example not responding on 443/udp 4501 from 3 probe locations.

LT-3300.detail: MFA push not acknowledged within 60 s; registered authenticator last seen 2026-08-30.
